title: Rule 7 clarification: are non-graphic fantasy tower-defense screenshots allowed?
author: Yopkillerr
selftext:
I’m preparing a development post about my AI-assisted browser tower-defense prototype. Its gameplay shows guardian projectiles, fantasy enemies and health bars, with no blood, gore or real-world violent themes.



Rule 7 prohibits violent content, but I couldn’t find whether that includes this kind of non-graphic fantasy combat. Are screenshots of that gameplay permitted in a properly flaired development post, or should game media be limited to scenes without combat?



Could a moderator clarify the applicable standard before I share any game media? Thank you.

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
I mean, people have been posting very blood-and-guts content here. 

\*shrug\*
